title: Ṭhānā
text: 2. Kāmarāgaṭṭhāniyānam bhikkhave dhammānam manasikārabahulīkārā anuppanno ceva kāmacchando uppajjati uppanno ca kāmacchando bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati || || 3. Byāpādaṭṭhāniyānam bhikkhave dhammānam manasikārabahulīkārā anuppanno ceva byāpādo uppajjati || uppanno ca byāpado bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati || || 4. Thīnamiddhaṭṭhāniyānam bhikkhave dhammānam manasikārabahulīkārā anuppannañ ceva thīnamiddham uppajjati || uppannañca thīnamiddham bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati || || 5. Uddhaccakukkaccaṭṭhāniyānam bhikkhave dhammānam manasikārabahulīkārā anuppannañ ceva uddhaccakukkuccam uppajjati || uppannañ ca uddhaccakukkuccam bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati || || 6. Vicikicchāṭṭhāniyānam bhikkhave dhammānam manasikārabahulīkārā anuppannā ceva vicikicchā uppajjati || uppannā ca vicikicchā bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati || || 7. Satisambojjhaṅgaṭṭhāniyānam bhikkhave dhammānam manasikārabahulīkārā anuppanno ceva satisambojjhaṅgo uppajjati || upanno ca satisambojjhaṅgo bhāvanā pāripūriṃ gacchati || la-pe || 8. Upekhāsambojjhaṅgaṭṭhāniyānam bhikkhave dhammānam manasikārabahulīkārā anuppanno ceva upekhāsambojjhaṅgo uppajjati || uppanno ca upekhāsambojjhaṅgo bhāvanā pāripūrim gacchatī ti || ||
